Name: Experience Rate Multiplier
Author: MSCFC
Description:
Experience Multiplier is a simple mod that allows you to customize the rates you gain experience at, for each individual skill (including the hidden luck skill) and in general.
You can change the rates in the mod's config file.
Source code available at [url=https://github.com/iSkLz/ExperienceMultiplier/]GitHub[/url].

Manifest.Name: Experience Multiplier Mod
Manifest.Description: Allows changing the rare you gain experience at.
